tasks.gr12-climate-and-geomorphology-revision-: Topic: Climate and geomorphology revision. Revise mid-latitude cyclones, tropical cyclones, anticyclones, local climates, drainage basins, fluvial erosion, river profiles and catchment management. Ask Grade 12 learners to answer integrated exam-style revision questions.
tasks.gr12-settlements-revision-t4: Topic: Settlements revision. Revise site and situation, rural settlement patterns, rural depopulation, urban hierarchy, threshold and range, informal settlements, service delivery and urban planning. Ask Grade 12 learners to complete integrated revision questions on settlements.
tasks.gr12-economic-geography-and-mapwork-revi: Topic: Economic geography and mapwork revision. Revise economic sectors, agriculture, food security, mining, manufacturing, informal trade, IDZs, SDIs, GIS, atlas skills and exam-style data interpretation. Ask Grade 12 learners to answer integrated revision questions based on South African examples.
